articles.summary: Hosting guests is changing what Americans want in a home: 58% say it has made them rethink what they want in their current or future home, according to a survey of 2,000 U.S. adults* conducted by Talker Research on behalf of KB Home (NYSE: KBH), one of the largest and most trusted homebuilders in the U.S. As many Americans prepare to welcome friends and family for the holidays, the survey highlights the pride, pressure and priorities that come with welcoming guests into the home. Among the top findings: More than half of Americans (58%) say hosting has made them rethink what they want in their current or future home. Nearly 3 in 10 hosts (29%) say having people over makes them feel proud of their home. Yet 1 in 5 (20%) say having guests over makes them feel self-conscious about their home. articles.title: The hosting effect: 58% of Americans say hosting guests has made them rethink what they want in a home
